local_name_policy: Preserve safe DOS83; otherwise ASCII-case-folded CRC32 as eight hex digits plus safe short extension or DAT
collision_policy: Exact active wire identity; existing local targets explicitly ZSKIP with no overwrite

collision_example.policy: Active identity mismatch aborts; existing target is explicitly skipped without overwrite

names.scope: Independent Python CRC32/local-name oracle, actual C bounded metadata codec and actual ZMODEM engine with recording transport/storage callbacks. Full wire identity, CRC16/32 retry and collision/skip policy. No DOS filesystem or BBS completion claim from host callbacks.

engine.scope: Maintained session engine with host transport/storage callbacks and independent pinned lrzsz pipes; optional selected stock Synchronet sexyz stdio helper uses two nonempty files only. No DOS filesystem/16-bit callback ABI, terminal UART/UI, physical modem or BBS session claim.

window.scope: Independent reactive Python CRC/header/data peer; host C callbacks, full duplex/overlap and finite-capacity policy, delayed/fragmented/stale ACK, window and buffer invariants, midstream/EOF recovery, future ACK, raw CAN and confirmed-progress separation. No actual DOS/UART/BBS or physical timing claim.

DOS.scope: Actual source-built 8086 DOS session engine with far callbacks and real checked receive filesystem owner. Wire input is scripted, source callbacks diagnostic stdio; not the terminal source/transport/UI adapter or a live DOS UART/BBS session.

retained_failure.reason: Initial adapter padded a short-name missing metadata terminator; existing regression rejected it. Final codec requires both terminators within the actual frame.

limitations: A different remote name with the same local alias is explicitly skipped if that target exists; receiving to another directory preserves both.
Full filename UI/catalog mapping remains unfinished; wire names are bounded opaque bytes with ASCII-only case folding.
Actual BBS download uses an isolated staged ENiGMA decoder; live install/catalog and physical RS-232 Wi-Fi modem validation remain open.
No complete PCPlus or universal BBS compatibility claim.
